title: 2025上海马拉松赛事即将鸣枪起跑
publisher: 上海市人民政府（黄浦区人民政府）
claims: The 2025 race starts at 07:00 on 30 November with three waves; the wheelchair race starts at 06:45.
The Shanghai Marathon is the only Abbott World Marathon Majors candidate race in China.
Pre-registrations reached 356,589, with a 7.2% marathon ballot success rate.
About 43 elite athletes and 19 wheelchair athletes were invited, including 12 international wheelchair racers.
Aid: drinks every 5 km from 5 km; water every 5 km from 7.5 km; nine energy stations from 12.5 km offering bananas, chocolate, small cakes and SiS gels; six ice stations; eight spray stations.
Race pack collection runs 27-29 November, 09:30-19:30, at the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center, 850 Bocheng Road.
